{{Quote|The Emperor had long been interested in the Sorcerers of Tund, since their religious teachings were based on an archaic interpretation of original Sith doctrine. Gepta used his Croke powers of illusion to infiltrate that secret society, co-opt its Sith teachings, and then annihilate it&mdash;Tund is now an uninhabited, irradiated wasteland, and the death of Gepta marked an end to the Sorcerers of Tund.|An extract from [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al's]] [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|''The New Essential Chronology'']]|<ref name="NEC" />}}
In [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], the [[Croke]] [[Rokur Gepta]] brought about the '''destruction''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tund/Legends|Tund]] using a [[Rokur Gepta's biological weapon|biological agent]] released by an [[electromagnetic torpedo]]. Gepta's weapon eradicated all life on Tund, killing upwards of eighteen million [[Sith (species)/Legends|pureblooded Sith]] and [[Toong/Legends|Toongs]] in residence on the planet. Tund's surface was subsequently rendered uninhabitable and its atmosphere poisoned from the resultant radioactive fallout, save for a small section of the planet protected by Gepta's [[Force field/Legends|force fields]].

==History==
[[File:Tund.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A pair of Toong walk the grounds of Tund.]]
Sometime prior to [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> [[Rokur Gepta]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] member of the snail-like [[Croke]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Crakull]],<ref name="NEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> took up residence on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tund/Legends|Tund]], an isolated [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] lost on the north-eastern borders of the [[Open Sea/Legends|Open Sea]].<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="ACGttC">{{GamerCite|5|A Campaign Guide to the Centrality}}</ref> In addition to hosting a [[Toong/Legends|Toong]] diaspora that settled the world in [[45 BBY/Legends|45 BBY]] after the destruction of [[Toong'l/Legends|Toong'l]],<ref name="TCSWEIII267">{{CSWECite|III|267|Tund}}</ref> Tund was historically home to a colony of [[Sith (species)/Legends|pureblooded Sith]] that had first colonized the planet in the aftermath of the [[27,700 BBY]] [[invasion of Korriban]] and subsequently come to host other Sith-blooded outcasts, exiles, and refugees from the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] and [[Sith Empire/Legends|old Sith Empire]].<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="KOTORCGWE5">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/KOTORweben5|text=KOTOR Campaign Guide Web Enhancement 5: Karnak Tetsu, Sorcerer of Tund}}</ref>

Following his arrival, Gepta successfully applied his species's natural powers of illusion and shapeshifting to a furtive infiltration of the [[Sorcerers of Tund/Legends|Sorcerers of Tund]],<ref name="NEGtC" /><ref name="TDSS">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> a monastic sect of pureblooded Sith Force users in residence on the planet.<ref name="TDSS" /><ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> The Croke studied the group's unique interpretations of ancient Sith teachings for some time, co-opting its secrets for his own purposes.<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="NEGtC" /> Having learned all he could from his unwary teachers,<ref name="TDSS" /> Gepta unleashed an [[electromagnetic torpedo]] containing a [[Rokur Gepta's biological weapon|biological agent]] upon Tund. The resultant green fire generated by these weapons eradicated all life on Tund and poisoned its atmosphere, transforming the once verdant world from a [[Living Force/Legends|lush]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Vergence/Legends|nexus]] to an [[Radiation/Legends|irradiated]] wasteland.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="NEGtC" /><ref name="TCSWEIII267" /><ref name="JvS" />

[[File:Tund_TEA.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Once strong in the Living Force, Tund was rendered an irradiated wasteland.]]
At the time of its destruction, the planet Tund hosted a total population of roughly eighteen million sentients. The species mix primarily consisted of approximately thirteen million, one hundred and forty thousand Toong, who made up seventy-three percent of the population; one million, two hundred and sixty thousand pureblooded Sith, who made up seven percent of the population; and a diverse assortment of other species numbering approximately three million, six hundred thousand beings, forming twenty percent of the population.<ref name="TEA" /> Apart from Gepta himself, all those in residence on the planet [[Death/Legends|died]] as a result of the planet's destruction, leaving Gepta as the last Sorcerer of Tund.<ref name="JvS" />

Either in exchange for Tundan secrets or out of respect for the Croke's abilities, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] of the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Banite Sith]] and an individual who had long sought to possess the ancient Sith secrets of the Sorcerers of Tund,<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="TEA" /><ref name="NEGtC" /><ref name="JvS" /> appointed Gepta the presiding [[Scrivinir]] of the Centrality and gifted the Croke a decommissioned Imperial cruiser named the ''[[Wennis]]'' with which to consolidate his hold over the remote region of space.<ref name="NEGtC" /><ref name="TDSS" /> Prior to his death at the hands of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] less than a year later,<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="NEGtC" /> Gepta returned to Tund on an intermittent basis, meditating in a small enclave protected from the planet's radioactive atmosphere by a system of [[Force field/Legends|force fields]].<ref name="NEGtC" /><ref name="TCSWEIII267" />
